name: Ohota na Snarka
source: The visual novel tells the story of how the fates of random people intertwine after destiny brings them to a strange desert world, where the wreckage of giant mechanisms towers on the horizon. Yet, they experience the very same problems, joys, and sorrows as we do.
translation: 这部视觉小说讲述了命运将随机的人们带到一个奇怪的沙漠世界后，他们的命运如何交织在一起的故事，巨大机械的残骸耸立在地平线上。然而，他们和我们一样经历着同样的问题、欢乐和悲伤。
